content_sections.heading: CUO Guest Faculty Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 4 for Guest Faculty (Logistics & Supply Chain Management).

content_sections.heading: CUO Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in concerned specialization from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign University. Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidates must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or Ph.D or a similar test like SLET/SET accredited by the UGC.

content_sections.heading: CUO Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs. 1500/- per lecture subject to maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: CUO Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
CUO Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the CUO Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and there is no specific last date for application mentioned. Candidates need to attend the interview on the scheduled date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: The salary is offered on a per-lecture basis, ranging from Rs. 1500/- per lecture, with a maximum monthly cap of Rs. 50,000/-.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications for the Guest Faculty role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in the concerned specialization and have cleared NET/CSIR NET, or hold a Ph.D., or have cleared SLET/SET.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Central University of Odisha, Koraput, Odisha - 763004.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Faculty position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the Guest Faculty in Logistics & Supply Chain Management.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is contractual.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and category certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the walk-in interview date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 01 September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Is there an age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limit for this recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the detailed advertisement.
